posts.description: What was approved, one entry per platform. The post steps publish approved_text unchanged. Give posts, or linkedin_text and/or x_text.

approved_text.description: The exact text the person approved.

linkedin_text.description: The approved LinkedIn text, when posts is absent.

x_text.description: The approved X text, when posts is absent.

now.description: Current time, ISO 8601. Used as posted_at and in report.meta. Optional: on JoyStream the template binds it to the run start time. Never guessed.
